name: Splunk Observability Cloud
summary: Splunk Observability Cloud sells editions by host. APM comes with App & Infra at $60 a host a month and End-to-End at $75, both billed annually, while the $15 Infrastructure edition has no APM. The APM product stores 100% of traces for search.

facts.text: Trace search covers any combination of tag values, errors and latencies, and the page states that 100% of traces are stored.
The page says users can receive alerts on slow response times or problematic queries for common databases.
The APM product is described as OpenTelemetry-native.

plans.name: Infrastructure
plans.notes: Starting price, billed annually. Does not include APM

plans.name: App & Infra
plans.notes: Starting price, billed annually. Includes APM with Always On Profiling

plans.name: End-to-End
plans.notes: Starting price, billed annually. Includes APM with Always On Profiling

hiddenCosts: All listed prices are starting prices billed annually, and the page directs buyers to request a quote.
The page does not list a monthly billing option or a trial length, though it offers a free edition download.
